title: Contact and Help for Members
subTitle: We have detailed instructions that answer frequently asked questions in our help area. You can read these in English and Vietnamese and answer many of your questions in a quick and uncomplicated way.
note: Of course you can also contact us personally. You can reach our English and Vietnamese customer support team through this contact sheet.
autographsDes: As we are not an agency, we can not help you with any autograph requests. Any requests will therefore be deleted. Please contact the agency or the actress/actor directly. You may find their contact details on their profiles under “Contact”.
